reference.title: Scenario 12 — Image with Alt Text
reference.shortdesc: Alt text is a short text description added to an image in .docx using Format

section.p: Alt text is a short text description added to an image in .docx using Format Picture > Alt Text. It describes the visual content for readers who cannot see the image, such as those using screen readers.

row.entry: [Alt text applied to image: "Diagram showing the print head path located inside the printer"]

entry.codeblock: <image href="media/print_head_diagram.png"> <alt>Diagram showing the print head path located inside the printer</alt> </image>

section.p: Result: The converter extracts alt text from each image and maps it to the <alt> element inside the <image> element in DITA. If no alt text is present, the <alt> element is omitted from the output.
